meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正计划在 Azure 上搭建生产级 Kubernetes 集群。
copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning to set up production-grade Kubernetes clusters on Azure.

howto.what: 根据你的需求输出一套建议的 AKS 集群配置,区分 Day-0 决策(如网络、API 服务器)与 Day-1 功能。覆盖集群类型、网络、安全、监控、升级、成本等,必要时调用 Azure MCP 工具或给出 CLI 命令。
howto.when: 当你想创建或配置 AKS 集群、设计其网络、选择 SKU 等时,它会接管。

say.text: 设计 AKS 网络,推荐用 Azure CNI Overlay 吗?
say.note: 它会解释 Pod IP 模型并给出推荐。

say.text: 如何为 AKS 启用自动缩放和设置维护窗口?
say.note: 它会说明相关配置步骤。

howto.what_en: Produces a recommended AKS configuration based on your needs, separating Day-0 (networking, API) from Day-1 features. Covers type, network, security, observability, upgrades, cost; may call Azure tools or output CLI commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create/configure an AKS cluster, design its networking, or choose a SKU.

say_en.text: Plan a production AKS cluster. Should I choose Automatic or Standard?
say_en.note: Provides a cluster type recommendation with rationale.

say_en.text: Design AKS networking. Is Azure CNI Overlay recommended?
say_en.note: Explains pod IP model options and tradeoffs.

say_en.text: How do I enable autoscaling and set maintenance windows for AKS?
say_en.note: Details autoscaling and upgrade configuration steps.
